title: Character and lifted frequency
statement: Let $H$ be a subspace of the binary cube $\ br_2^n$, and let a binary subspace split identify that cube linearly with $H$ times a complementary binary cube. For each complementary frequency $\gamma$, the character that evaluates the dot product of $\gamma$ with the complementary coordinate of a point $z$ equals the sign encoding of the dot product of the lifted frequency with $z$.
hypotheses_covered: A subspace $H$ of the binary cube of dimension $n$
A frequency $\gamma$ in the complementary binary cube
